ASSIGNMENT OF CLAIM

For value received, the sufficiency of which is acknowledged, Merrivale Optics GmbH, a German limited liability company with its registered office at Hafenstrasse 22, 20359 Hamburg, Germany ("Assignor"), unconditionally and irrevocably sells, transfers, and assigns to Wexley Distressed Opportunities Fund II, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership with offices at 1 Sound Shore Drive, Greenwich, Connecticut 06830 ("Assignee"), all of Assignor's right, title, and interest in and to the claim described below.

1. THE CLAIM. The claim assigned is Assignor's general unsecured claim against Calloway Photonics, Inc. (the "Debtor") in the amount of $1,284,650.19, arising from goods sold and delivered under purchase orders CP-4417 through CP-4462, and scheduled by the Debtor at Schedule F of its schedules of assets and liabilities as claim number 3-1041 in the case captioned In re Calloway Photonics, Inc., Case No. 26-11284 (Bankr. D. Del.) (the "Case"), together with all of Assignor's rights arising from or relating to that claim (collectively, the "Claim").

2. PURCHASE PRICE. Assignee shall pay Assignor $591,939.09, being forty-six and one-tenth percent (46.1%) of the face amount of the Claim, by wire transfer of immediately available funds within three (3) business days after Assignor delivers this executed Assignment of Claim and the supporting documentation described in Section 5.

3. ASSIGNOR'S REPRESENTATIONS. Assignor represents and warrants to Assignee that:

3.1 Assignor is the sole legal and beneficial owner of the Claim and has not sold, assigned, pledged, or encumbered it, in whole or in part, to any other person;

3.2 the Claim is valid, undisputed, liquidated, and enforceable against the Debtor in the amount stated, and is not subject to any objection, setoff, defense, counterclaim, subordination, avoidance, reduction, or impairment;

3.3 Assignor has not received any payment or other distribution on account of the Claim, and no proof of claim other than the scheduled claim has been filed;

3.4 Assignor has performed all obligations giving rise to the Claim and no goods remain to be delivered;

3.5 Assignor is not an insider or affiliate of the Debtor within the meaning of Section 101(31) of the Bankruptcy Code, and has not received any transfer avoidable under Sections 547 or 548 of the Bankruptcy Code;

3.6 Assignor has full power and authority to execute and deliver this Assignment of Claim, and this Assignment of Claim is Assignor's legal, valid, and binding obligation, enforceable in accordance with its terms; and

3.7 the execution and delivery of this Assignment of Claim violates no law, order, or agreement binding on Assignor.

4. REPURCHASE AND INDEMNITY. If the Claim is disallowed, reduced, subordinated, objected to, or otherwise impaired, in whole or in part, for any reason other than Assignee's own act, Assignor shall, within ten (10) business days after written notice, repay to Assignee that portion of the purchase price attributable to the impaired amount, together with interest at eight percent (8%) per year from the date of payment. Assignor shall also indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Assignee against any loss, cost, or expense, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising out of a breach of any representation in Section 3 or out of any claim asserted against Assignee on account of an act or omission of Assignor. This Section 4 survives the closing and is not limited by any other provision of this Assignment of Claim.

5. DELIVERIES AND FURTHER ASSURANCES. Assignor shall deliver to Assignee, concurrently with this Assignment of Claim, copies of the invoices, purchase orders, proofs of delivery, and correspondence supporting the Claim. Assignor shall execute and deliver any further instrument, including an evidence of transfer under Federal Rule of Bankruptcy Procedure 3001(e), and take any further action Assignee reasonably requests to give effect to this assignment or to enable Assignee to prosecute the Claim.

6. VOTING AND DISTRIBUTIONS. Assignee is entitled to vote the Claim, to file and prosecute any proof of claim, and to receive all distributions on the Claim. If Assignor receives any distribution on the Claim after the date of this Assignment of Claim, Assignor shall hold it in trust for Assignee and deliver it to Assignee within five (5) business days, endorsed as necessary.

7. NO ASSUMPTION. Assignee assumes no obligation or liability of Assignor of any kind, whether arising before or after the date of this Assignment of Claim.

8. NOTICE TO THE COURT. Assignee may file this Assignment of Claim with the clerk of the Bankruptcy Court. Assignor waives any notice or hearing that Bankruptcy Rule 3001(e) may require, and consents to the substitution of Assignee for Assignor for all purposes in the Case.

9. GENERAL.

9.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Assignment of Claim is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Assignor and Assignee each irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Bankruptcy Court in the Case and, if that court lacks jurisdiction, the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.

9.2 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Assignment of Claim is the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the Claim and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

9.3 Counterparts. This Assignment of Claim may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Assignment of Claim as of November 12, 2026.

MERRIVALE OPTICS GMBH
